title: habenaria seshagiriana
intro: Habenaria seshagiriana, commonly known as Seshagiria, is a species of orchid native to the Western Ghats of India. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Seshagiria include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help in reducing oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Seshagiria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic, anti-bacterial, and anti-cancer activities.
